theme_strategy: Light mode by default (best for dense data/ERP reading). Dark mode toggle required, but optimize for high-contrast light mode.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant for industrial tools: Structural sans headings with mono-spaced numbers for precision.

scale.table_header: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500 font-mono

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
ALL numeric values (currency, inches, quantities, pricing) MUST use IBM Plex Mono to align decimals vertically.
Table headers must be uppercase, heavily tracked (tracking-widest).
95% of the UI must be monochrome (White, Grays, Black).
The blue accent (#2495D3) is reserved EXCLUSIVELY for interactive elements (primary buttons, active tabs, focus rings, selected rows) and key final calculation metrics.
DO NOT use full-screen gradients. Color is function only.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Mode B: High Density Grid (Dashboards / Analytics) modified for ERP.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6 for nested elements; p-8 for main module containers.
rules: No dead space, but no visual clutter. Use 1px borders instead of deep shadows to separate zones.
All major modules must follow a Split Layout: Data/Inputs on the left (stretches), Real-time Estimate/Summary on the right (sticky).
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (e.g., p-6) to prevent text collision.

surfaces_and_components.strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton.
surfaces_and_components.border_radius: Max 4px (rounded-sm) globally. No bubbly or overly rounded corners. Industrial and sharp.
surfaces_and_components.shadows: Minimal. Use 1px solid borders for definition. Only use shadow-lg on dropdowns, modals, and sticky floating bars.

header.style: Solid Background (bg-white) with a hard 1px bottom border (border-slate-200).
header.rules: NEVER use transparent backgrounds for the header or dropdowns.

features: Sticky header (bg-slate-50) and sticky first column (ID/Name).
Row height: compact (32px) or regular (40px). No massive padding in data tables.
Hover state: bg-slate-50 for the entire row.
Virtualization must be simulated/implemented for tables with 100+ rows (e.g., Paper Stocks, Products).

forms_and_inputs.components: Use Shadcn JS components (NOT TSX) for Input, Select, Checkbox. Heavily customize to remove rounding.

buttons.primary: bg-[#2495D3] hover:bg-[#1E7AA9] text-white rounded-sm font-semibold transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-black rounded-sm transition-colors

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces, 1px border border-slate-200, bg-white, NO shadow by default.

auth.layout: Minimalist center block. White card on gray background. Blue accent for submit.

dashboard.layout: Bento Grid. High density. Top-left North Star Metric (e.g., Daily Quotes Volume).
dashboard.components: Quick access cards to modules, recent estimates table.

paper_printing.layout: Split view. Left: Tabular selection of 100+ stocks. Right: Imposition Calculator.
paper_printing.calculator: Input fields for flat size, finished size. Auto-calculate 'up' on sheet. Display comparison grid of costs across standard quantities (e.g., 250, 500, 1000).

booklet_module.layout: Wizard or Stepper approach inside a single view.
booklet_module.steps: Cover Paper -> Inside Paper -> Page Count -> Binding Option.
booklet_module.pricing: Sticky bottom or right-side summary updating in real-time.

large_format.layout: Material selection table + Multi-size estimating grid.
large_format.grid: Spreadsheet-like grid allowing up to 25 size inputs (W x H x Qty).
large_format.visualization: Abstract visual representation of nesting/tiling (e.g., small bounding boxes inside a roll width). Use D3 or basic canvas for simple 2D nesting vis.

sticker_calculator.inputs: Sliders or numeric inputs for size (1-8 inches).
sticker_calculator.comparison: Side-by-side card comparison of 'Paper' vs 'Vinyl' vs 'Holographic' costs.

equipment_settings.layout: Master-detail view. Left sidebar with printers, right pane with ink config, click charges, and markup %.

rules: Micro-animations ONLY. No large sweeping page transitions.
Use framer-motion for calculator number ticking (animating from $10.00 to $15.00).
Hover states must be instant (150ms) for a snappy, technical feel.
All dropdowns and select menus must slide in with subtle opacity (duration 200ms).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA minimums. #2495D3 against white is accessible for UI, but text inside blue buttons must be pure white.
testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a B2B ERP tool, not a consumer landing page. Prioritize information density, alignment, and fast data entry.
Use Javascript (.js/.jsx) for all components, NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Install and use 'lucide-react' for crisp, technical iconography. (e.g., Settings, Calculator, Printer, LayoutGrid).
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications on save/calculate actions.
Shadcn Setup: Initialize with base color 'slate', radius '0'. Customize components heavily to match the sharp, industrial 'Grid Borders' style.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN). Everything is left-aligned unless specific to a numeric table column.
No emojis in the UI. Use proper SVG icons.
Calculators MUST clearly visually separate inputs (forms) from outputs (large blue text).
Table headers must stick to the top on scroll.
Avoid TS-specific syntax; provide vanilla JS React functional components.
universal_agent_guidelines: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop'. Give the UI a sharp, deliberate, technical aesthetic.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through 1px borders and layered z-index hierarchy, NOT massive shadows.
Always use modern button styles, specifically the sharp rectangular buttons defined in surfaces_and_components.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
